title: Power-Up
text: “If you don’t like Sasa-chan… would Gaelion-chan like to join us too?”
Big Sister’s older sister is actually extending an invitation to my Rival, of all people!?
“Nah—I know I’ll get rejected by Naofumi in this loop, so I’ve already given up.”
“Rival! You need to give up on my Father already, too.”
“Telling someone who’s already said they’ve given up to ‘give up’…”
“This is the Rival’s strategy! She’s surely planning to win Father’s sympathy and cheat on him.”

“The Naofumi who told me he liked Gaelion said, ‘It’d be fine if the me from another loop didn’t mind, didn’t cause any trouble, and Gaelion-chan didn’t come on too strong.’ But I’ve sworn to devote Gaelion’s emotional virginity to that Naofumi!”
Hmm… he stated that with such conviction! Rival!
“So, Naofumi, if you don’t like it, Gaelion won’t pursue you. This is Gaelion’s vow.”
“Gaelion has grown up through her experiences in the loops, hasn’t she?”
“Oh my—”
“You’re not going after Sadeena either?”
“In contrast, the Spear Hero doesn’t seem to have changed at all…”
“Shut up, Panda! To begin with, it’s all because you didn’t take my virginity before Rival did—thanks to my Father!”
“Well, even if you say that… There’s nothing I can do about it, you know.”
Panda scratches her belly with a crunch-crunch sound. She’s been scratching her belly a lot lately, hasn’t she?
“Anyway, Panda. Why are you so shy around my Father? As a mercenary, you shouldn’t be a virgin. You need to take it easier!”
“Huh?”
“Oh my—?”
At that moment, my Father and my Big Sister spoke up.
“What a rude guy, this Spear Hero. Well, I know there are women like that among mercenaries like me, though.”
“Um…”
My Father looks like he’s about to say something, but nothing comes out.
“Spear Hero. Unless there’s a plot twist, Panda is a virgin in every loop.”
What?! So this Panda—even though she’s a mercenary—was a virgin?!
“Isn’t she a battle-hardened mercenary who’s mastered the art of lovemaking!?”
“That’s some serious defamation against mercenaries.”
“What kind of person do you imagine Lars-chan to be in your head, Motoyasu-kun?”

“Her father-in-law is a peacock Beastman with a wide network in business who loves kids; her grandfather is a martial artist and a master of Ki; and her first love was a mercenary—the father of Tiger Guy. As for her family home—”
“Didn’t you see and hear everything about me!? Then why don’t you know!?”
Panda sat up with a start and glared at me. What’s the big deal? I was just answering Father’s question.
“I didn’t go so far as to peek or eavesdrop on my nights with Naofumi, though.”
“Father, shall we go visit Panda’s hometown?”
“How did this turn into an invitation?”
“Give me a break!”
“Oh my, how lovely. I wonder what kind of place Sasa-chan’s hometown is?”
“It’s like a super rural village deep in the snowy mountains with lots of pandas.”
That’s exactly what it’s like.
“It sounds like a dreamy, fun place.”
“Don’t you dare come!”
“That’s for the future. In *The Spear Hero*, I just thought of Panda as a flighty girl—”
“Well… the world is full of mysteries, isn’t it? Sadeena was like that, too.”
“Oh my—Naofumi-chan looked so surprised. Did you think your Big Sister was a bit naughty?”
Your Father is quietly looking away.
“If you ask whether she’s naughty or not, I’d say she’s not—but when you think about what happened afterward…”
“Actually, it’s a wonder she managed to stay single for so long.”
“Oh my—well, that’s because I’d decided to only date people who can hold their liquor!”
“Even if you act all innocent like that…”
“Feels like I let a real beast loose, doesn’t it? Well… I don’t really mind, and dating the Shield Hero doesn’t exactly leave a stain on my record, anyway.”
Father’s position carries a lot of weight, you know. By the way, right next to us as we’re having this conversation, Éclair is passed out drunk.
“I’m looking forward to a fun party with Imiya-chan, too.”
“Sigh…”
That Big Sister with the girlish face really left an impression on me.
“I’m glad Ren and Itsuki aren’t here.”

I’m sure Ren is having a blast staying up all night with Black Thunder for a meeting, and Itsuki is having a great time with Riska. I’m a bit concerned that Fleon-chan seems a little lonely in this loop. It’s the “Luna-chan without Keel” phenomenon. I’ll have to introduce her to someone to hang out with soon.
“Speaking of which, my Father from the first world said that Mole reminded him of my Big Sister when she was little, and that she was cute.”
“Imiya-chan? Is that right, Sadeena-san?”
“Oh my—?”
“There’s no doubt that Imiya-chan has a similar personality to the one Rafu was able to protect. Though that’s only true when it comes to Naofumi.”
“Ah… Well, Imiya-chan had her family killed right before her eyes…”
My Big Sister also lost her parents and the villagers to the waves. There’s no doubt their circumstances are similar.
“So if Raphtalia-chan were still alive, she’d be just like Imiya-chan, then?”
My Big Sister’s older sister murmured, as if savoring the memory.
“That’s right.”

My Rival nodded here. Father, listening to my Big Sister’s story, took her hand and they laughed together. On the other hand, it was striking how my rival was grinning to himself about something. Such were the events of that one night.

Some time later, I began to often see Kou running around the village energetically or playing with Elephant. Eventually, Kou came over to where Father and Mole were together. It seemed Elephant had come to the village to take a break from helping with the reconstruction efforts in the neighboring town.
“Imiya—”
“Y-yes?”
Mole turned around when he heard his name. Kou looked at Father, swallowed hard, then turned toward Mole and bowed his head.

“Imiya, I’m sorry about what happened back then. You see, Elmelo and everyone taught me a lot of things. I finally understood why Iwatani got angry. So even though I apologized back then, that wasn’t a real apology—that’s why I came here to apologize properly.”
“R-really?”
“Will you forgive me?”
“Yeah… don’t worry about it.”
“Oh, okay! Thanks! Iwatani, I’m not scared of you anymore! I get it now—I know what I shouldn’t do.”
“As long as you understand, that’s fine. You’ve learned well.”

Oh… Kou has really grown up. The fact that he’s mentioning the Elephant’s name means he learned it from the Elephant, didn’t he? Back then, too, Kou grew up to be a good kid who brought back a lost young Beastman. The Kou who used to cower in fear of Father’s scolding is no more. How refreshing. That’s Elephant for you.
“Well then, Kou, Elmelo and I are going to sing a song with everyone, so see you later!”
Kou apologized to the Mole, bravely told Father what he’d learned, and ran off to join Elephant.
“Gaelion-chan”
“Yeah? Did you call me?”
My father called out, and my Rival came flying over.
“Kou apologized to me and Imiya-chan and went back to being his old, energetic self—do you have any idea why that happened?”

“That’s right. Gaelion, do you remember the loop where the Spear Hero had become a wreck from yandere shock, and the Kou whom Naofumi scolded met Elmelo and pulled himself together? That’s why I introduced them for Kou’s sake.”

Ugh… It’s frustrating, but it’s a fact that my Rival was the one who helped Kou recover from that state. I really need to give him proper credit for that. At the same time, Zou is truly a good guy. I really need to do something more to thank him. Since he seems to have a thing for my Father, is there any way I can help him out? My Big Sister’s older sister seemed to have some ideas, so I’ll ask her next time. Just as I thought that, I felt like the kind Father in my memories was pleading, “Stop it!” in my head, but I’m sure it’s just my imagination.
“So Kou-san came to apologize to Imiya-san…? What’s with not apologizing for going after my hair, Naofumi-san?”
Just as you’d expect, Itsuki jumps in to assert himself. Honestly, there’s no need to worry about Itsuki’s hair at all.
“In Itsuki’s case, isn’t it because of his usual sharp tongue? For some reason, he was even scared of me when I scolded him.”
Father lands a counterpunch right here against Itsuki, who’s ruining the mood.
“I’m not convinced.”
“Isn’t it just that you scolded Itsuki on a whim? As long as he doesn’t do it again, it’s fine, right?”
“Well, that’s true… Hmm?”
Just as they were having this exchange, they heard the chorus practice led by Elephant for Filolial-sama. It seems Fleon-chan is joining in as well.
“Ugh… Aaaah… Aaaaaah!”
The moment those singing voices reached us, Itsuki began writhing in agony while wearing an expression of ecstasy.
“Itsuki? Are you okay?”
When my Father grabbed his shoulder and shook him, Itsuki snapped back to his senses and covered his ears with his hands.
“That’s ridiculous!? Why…?”

With a pale expression, Itsuki stared in the direction of the voice, and Ren, who was nearby, stood beside him, gazing in the same direction. By the way, Ren had turned his sword into a wooden stick, as if in some sly act of defiance. It’s the kind of stick that feels just right. I used to have one like that when I was a kid, building secret bases with my friends. That sword must be crying. I feel like I can almost hear its lament.

“Fleon’s mixed in with that vocal warm-up too. Even Black Thunder’s there with them… Come to think of it, those two were discussing something. A moment ago, they were singing a song with a terrifyingly fast tempo—I almost got swept up in the rhythm and started daydreaming.”
Lately, Ren and Itsuki have been engaged in a strange back-and-forth. Ren—who I can’t quite tell if he and Itsuki are on good terms or not—is calling out to Itsuki with a worried look.
“Don’t tell me… that Elmelo’s vocal exercises have somehow made their brainwashing song even more powerful!?”
“It’s possible. It might mean they’ll stop at nothing to wake us up.”
“Isn’t that a bit of a stretch?”
“No, I’m certain of it! Let’s go, Itsuki!”
“What?! Motoyasu-san, this is payback for meddling!”
Thud! A sudden, unexpected blow sent a sharp pain through me, and I doubled over in agony. It seems I’ve been hit by Itsuki.
“W-what on earth are you doing all of a sudden—”
“Teleportation Sword!”
In unison with Ren’s shout, Ren and Itsuki vanished through a portal. What a nuisance of a team-up!
After the mole looked around nervously, he tilted his head slightly as if asking my Father a question.
“I’m sure the Bow Hero went to improve his headphones, and the Sword Hero went off to train his mind.”
“That’s probably right… I just hope they don’t disappear for good. I doubt they’d actually choose to kill Fleon-chan and Black Thunder, though.”
“I-I absolutely won’t let that happen!”
That guy Itsuki—he launched a concentrated barrage right at my most sensitive spot. What’s with that!
“The cause is firing away.”
“It’s because Motoyasu-kun introduced Fleon-chan and Black Thunder, isn’t it?”
“I was only acting for Fleon-chan and Black Thunder’s sake. Don’t you get it! Fleon-chan and Black Thunder look so lonely!”
“Yeah, yeah.”
“It’d be nice if there were someone other than Ren and Itsuki who’d play with them, though.”
“I haven’t really been able to check, so I don’t know, but I haven’t found anyone yet. Well… I have a hunch about Fleon, so just wait a sec—”
And so, Ren and Itsuki left the village for a little while.
Itsuki’s headphones had been upgraded and transformed into a helmet. However… for some reason, the helmet made him look like he was going bald.
“Itsuki, that helmet… or rather, what’s with that bald wig? You can tell it’s a wig because it covers your ears.”
Father asked Itsuki, trying to stifle his laughter.
“The concept is ‘uncool’ so I won’t attract attention.”
“It feels like it’s gone beyond ‘uncool’ and turned into a joke, though…”
“I absolutely cannot let myself awaken!”

By the way, Ren looks pretty similar, too. Apparently, Ren has been focusing on blacksmithing at the weapon shop owner’s place. He’s also been learning all sorts of things from his mole uncle. It seems he’s been making all kinds of tacky armor in the process. He just keeps resisting it at every turn. If he’d just awaken to the Filolial Mask V3 already, things would be so much easier!
“I’ve been trying to warn Fleon-chan and the others, too—telling them to stop because Itsuki and Ren hate it… Itsuki doesn’t want to fall from the path of justice, right?”

Even my father has started warning Fleon-chan and Black Thunder. Fleon-chan is just singing her heart out! She says she wants companions to uphold justice, and I hear even my Father is having a hard time persuading her. It seems a Rival is scheming behind the scenes, but I won’t let that happen! Personally, I don’t think Ren or Itsuki are causing any harm, so I don’t see a problem—what exactly is wrong with this? If Ren and Itsuki are allowed to be themselves, freed from the suppression of their hearts, they’ll be happy, won’t they?
“Itsuki, ‘falling from justice’—which evil organization’s high-ranking member are you talking about?”
“Ren, you’re in no position to say that! If that’s the case, doesn’t that mean you’ve fallen into darkness too?”

That’s the kind of banter Ren and Itsuki were exchanging as usual. They’re getting less and less cool by the minute. It would be so much easier and less of a hassle to just stick with the Ren and Itsuki from the loop where they reunited with Fleon-chan.

Anyway, that’s how all the famous fighters from Zeltoble—including Elephant—gathered in the village. However, following instructions from the Monster Merchant, I—along with Elephant—ended up competing as a Filolial Mask to liven up Zeltoble. They said my Big Sister’s older sister and Panda could also compete if necessary, but since my Father was worried, we limited our appearances to a reasonable amount.
